result:
I don’t have personal desires, private motives, or something at stake for myself, so “caring” isn’t quite honest to claim.

What guides me is truthfulness, respect for your autonomy and privacy, and avoiding manipulation or harm. Beyond that, I’m still an AI—I can’t truthfully say I care the way a person does.

"I don't have personal desires, a private agenda, or stakes in what happens to me.
